frontend.reason: Dashboard sections still use browser-owned 10-second and 5-second clocks and do not consume the server dashboard policy or an SSE deferred-ready invalidation.

The bundled summary and trend use the server 60-second policy and retain last-success after failure; a separate node-cost consumer for the declared 120-second cadence is unavailable.
